integration: Load menu.css, copy .loop-nav with .loop-toggle, transparent .loop-scroll-zone, .loop-panel and seven .loop-link elements from index.html, then load menu.js as a module. No external runtime dependencies.
mobile: Same portrait/landscape mobile responsive rule. Portrait retains top/middle/bottom docks on each side. After6px tap slop, the dominant axis locks for the entire gesture (ties horizontal). Only that axis affects dragging and release: inward12px switches side; vertical24px advances a level. Cross-axis input never moves the dot or changes the other dock coordinate. All levels share fixed5%/95% columns, clamped for56px safe-area targets. Landscape allows bottom-left/right only; rotation normalizes to bottom on the same side and invalidates active docking gestures. Open menu stays opposite/level and keeps shared scrolling over links, gap and outlined trigger.
desktop: Seven source-style dots remain position:fixed at left30px/top50px while the document scrolls; verified with 757px body scrolling and exact unchanged dot bounds.
motion: Drag follows pointer, release decelerates into aligned row. Wheel/trackpad deltas are smoothed and gently aligned without injecting a second inertial tail. New input interrupts motion immediately; wrapping occurs outside clipped window. If a perpendicular gesture interrupts a resting trigger glide, native Web Animations settles along two straight segments; no diagonal interpolation. Reduced motion commits immediately, including preference changes.
accessibility: Native links/button/region; only centered link in tab order; ArrowUp/Down cycle following visual direction; Home/End; Enter; Escape returns focus to trigger. Resizing moves focus out of newly hidden content. Reduced-motion avoids coast and alignment animation. Pinch zoom allowed in touch region. While closed, focus trigger and use ArrowLeft/Right to choose handedness; hidden help documents the gesture. Trigger settling respects reduced motion. Closed portrait ArrowUp/Down steps through top/middle/bottom; closed landscape vertical arrows do not change docks; ArrowLeft/Right selects side. Open trigger tap still closes, while dragging it scrolls links and suppresses only the accidental trailing click.
